Name: Josibiah
Summary: Father of Jehu, son of Seraiah son of Asiel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:35: Father of Jehu, son of Seraiah son of Asiel.
LifeLesson: The mention of Josibiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
